lines.en: The manor grounds are eerily quiet today.
Normally, you’ll catch passing glimpses of gardeners, security workers, or whatever other sort of people the grossly wealthy typically employ.
Today, there’s no one — just Tsubasa and me as I’m led through building after building and eventually up into some tower I’ve never seen before.
It overlooks this entire kingdom of opulence and reminds me that I, too, am naught but one more expendable worker bee in her extravagant hive of forced employment.
The termite queen would never. Her soldiers are the type to clean her out of love, not because they’re shackled to stakes beside her undulating white flesh-mass.

Yet, the rewards those soldiers reap would be just that. And thoughts of greater wealth or ascendence would be little more than flashes in the same pan that will, one day, be used to cook them and serve them up to guests.
If I do as she says-
If I dance on her strings and let her get what she wants-
Surely I will be a very rich man. Surely.
But, in the event I am not when I do-
I hope that those who feast upon this body think of me as the human equivalent of the finest veal money can buy — with meat so tender from never exploring what’s outside of my cage.
These legs weren’t made for walking. They were meant to go limp and fold the moment the gates open.
: Allow me to introduce you to my own personal Heaven. Tyranny is so much easier in the bath with a nice merlot, you see.
: Thank you for the impromptu spa trip. I think I’d have preferred that onsen from a few years back though since I wouldn’t feel as imprisoned there.
: You can leave any time you like, Akira.
: Awesome. Then I will leave right now.
: Fine. Just know that, by doing so, you’ll be missing out on finally seeing me in the nude.
: God fucking damn it.
: Hahah! Oh, if only Touka was that easy to tempt into coming here. She’s starting to catch on to this place being my throne room and has been somewhat hesitant to bathe with me as of late.
: So we’re bathing together? That’s what’s going on here? I can totally see how such a thing will enrich your family’s future. It all makes sense now.
: You’re sounding awfully sarcastic for someone about to see what very few have, Akira. Perhaps I could entice you more if I was still battling puberty?
: Touka’s going to kill you for this, you know. She’s more fed up with your antics than even I am.
: How about we just forget she even exists from now until the end of the night? I love her dearly, but it’d hurt my feelings oh so badly if you were to be thinking of her while I’m fully exposed.

: No it wouldn’t. Knowing you and how willing you are to sacrifice your daughters to me, I’m not convinced you wouldn’t be whispering into my ear and asking me to tell you about my very many fantasies of her.
: Well, you didn’t have to make it sound so fun.
: So what’s the goal here? How do you spin a co-ed bathing session into something that makes your life easier? Because we both know this isn’t just some booty call.
: Do we? For all you know, I brought you up here to fuck me raw in the only place I can get some true privacy.
: It’s been ages for me, you know. I imagine you’d have no trouble at all making me whine and whimper with a skill-set like yours. I wouldn’t seem so scary then, would I?
: I’ve seen porn like this. Where a woman’s not being adequately loved and so she steals her daughter’s boyfriend instead.
: Tell me more. It might help me get into character.
: Take your clothes off if you want me to fuck you.
: Right now? You don’t intend to skip foreplay, do you? Because I’m one thing, but my girls deserve to be treated much better than that.
: Girl. Only one of them is on my radar. No matter how badly you want me to break the other one.
: We’ll see about that. Could I ask you to close your eyes for a moment?
: No.
: Oh.
: I guess I’ll just have to take matters into my own hands then! Enjoy your new home, Akira! I’ll let you out sometime today if you be a good boy!
: Wha- I knew I should have been suspicious about this locker! What do you think you’re doing?! And why are you so strong?!

: Have you never heard of hysterical strength before? It’s a relatively common occurrence in mothers suddenly thrown into life-threatening scenarios where adrenaline runs high and suppresses a body’s safety inhibitors.
: The analogy typically used involves lifting a car, though. And, with all due respect Akira, you’re not that big. Now, in you go. Hurry up.
: I...Tsubasa, this might not be the time, but I kind of have a thing with being forced into dark, enclosed spaces that I don’t really want to-
: Grin and bear with it. You’re Japanese, aren’t you? 我慢して! Your reward is right around the corner!
: I still don’t-
: I said 我慢して you stubborn brat!
: Tsubasa! Let me out of here! What the fuck is wrong with you?!
: Ah-ah-ah! Yelling will only get you in trouble, Aki-kun! Besides, I need to go undress. The moisture in the air here is already being quite unkind to my clothes.
: I don’t give a shit about your clothes! I-
: Akira, calm down. You are safe here. You have my word.
: Your word doesn’t mean anything when you’ve told me a thousand times that you just say shit...
: Hmmmmm? Did you say something, Akira? I’m sorry, but it’s just so hard to hear you in there.
: Forget it...
: I just need to...close my eyes...
There used to be a game I’d play when I was locked in the closet.
I’d count. From one up to whatever number I stopped at.
That was it.
And it wasn’t very fun, no. But it helped distract me from all of the sounds on the other side of the door.
The screaming. The moaning. The sound of the bed creaking and the headboard slamming against the wall.
I realized back then, perhaps even before then, that this was something people did to quell their raging feelings at times.
And I used to wonder when I, too, would have an outlet like that. Something to make the feelings stop.
And then I did.
And then they didn’t.
And now here I am again — right where I left off. A neglected animal with no one left to give me water.
This cage will not unlock again.
I watch her shower. She’s just as beautiful as I expected her to be. And it’s no mystery why Touka is the same.
She acknowledges my presence, glancing through the slits in the locker with a half-smile every thirty seconds or so to remind me that I’m not forgotten. But she never speaks.
And that is good. Because animals do not talk. And I don’t want to be tempted into thinking I’m more than I am.
The shower turns off and the water stops right away. When mine turns off, it keeps on dripping for a while.
She stands up and looks at me. Then says this-
: I need you to promise me you aren’t going to try and come out of there. Do you understand? It’ll look very bad for me if I need to hire a locksmith to pry that thing open if you damage the lock.
: Other than that, feel free to stare to your heart’s content. Stroke yourself if you like. Just don’t make any noise or you might scare Tsukasa.
: You can make noise now. She’s not here yet, silly.
: Tsukasa is coming?...
: Well, duh. You think I’d lock you up and force you to watch me bathe? I get nothing from that. This is practically a sales pitch. So sit back and enjoy the presentation, would you?
: Oh! And no recording either! I just realized I forgot to take your phone!
: We don’t want Touka catching you beating your cock to pictures of her family, do we? She’s still your number one. For now, at least.
: But who’s to say that doesn’t change after today? After you see with your own eyes just what and who you’re missing out on.
: Mother? May...I enter?
: Claim her, and you may have me as well. Together, if that’s what it takes.
: What?...
: Shh...It’s time to be a good boy again...
: I...I’m here. You wanted to...see me about something?
: Why do you look so nervous, dear? Is something wrong?
: No, it’s just...you don’t...normally let me in this room. This is where you and Onee-sama talk about...whatever it is you two talk about in here.
: You’re my daughter as well, Tsukasa. And today, I want to talk to you. Is that okay?
: About what? I’m not in trouble, am I? I haven’t even fired anybody this week.
: Tsukasa dear, come bathe with me. Let’s just relax today. There’s no need to talk about firing or anything related to the family. Enjoy the scenery. Come look out at our kingdom.
: I do love kingdoms. And the view from here is nicer than it is from my building...I’m just afraid I’ll annoy you again.
: You don’t annoy me, Tsukasa. I’m just very busy sometimes and can’t spare you the affection you need. Which is why-

: Apologies for interrupting, Mother, but this locker seems very out of place and suspicious. As prime targets for assassination, this is something we should be vigilant about. Shall I call the guards to check?
: Uh...no. I’ve already done that, darling. Just take your towel off and bathe with me. Before something tries to pull me away again.
: Mm...I feel like you’re always getting pulled away these days. And it’s not like Onee-sama wants to spend time with me either.
: Are you feeling lonely, dear?
: No, I’m fine. I have Chinami. And everyone else is busy, so I need to keep doing my part and not getting in the way of anything.
: Are the two of you still studying together? And how is Chika? I feel like it’s been ages since I’ve last seen her.

: I don’t know, actually. Sometimes she’s really nice and other times, she looks like she’s going to jump off a skyscraper. She’s always holding a knife too. I don’t get it. Like, it’s literally all the time.
: Teenagers are quite temperamental. That’s likely why your sister hasn’t had much time for you either.
: No, Onee-sama is just always with her weird friend now. And when it’s not her, it’s Jeeves- which means I can’t really see him either.
: Stop calling him Jeeves, dear. His name is Akira. If you want to have an actual relationship with him, that’s a good place to start.
: He doesn’t want me to call him that. I don’t think he even likes me. He seems annoyed any time I try to have him teach me about stuff.
: Besides, wouldn’t calling him by his name just make it like how it was when I had a rabbit? I’d get attached and be more upset when he stops coming to see me.
: Oh, Tsukasa...Akira will be in our family for a long time. He’s not leaving us any time soon.
: Yeah, but if he does, it’ll be because Onee-sama purchased the rights to his existence and decided to marry him. And she’ll ban me from seeing him altogether if that happens.
: Aww...you’re scared, aren’t you? That your first ever crush won’t go anywhere.
: Crush?
: It’s the word for when you really like someone and want to spend more time with them.
: Oh. Like you and that Yuki lady?
: That...uh...no. No, Yuki and I are just friends. We-
: You must be really good friends then with the way you stare at her. If Chinami stared at me like that, I’d think she got infected with something.
: Ahem. We...are very good friends, Tsukasa. Yuki and I have known each other for longer than you’ve been alive. But we’re not talking about her right now. We’re talking about you and Akira.
: I see. Then...do you think I have a crush on him? Does Onee-sama have a crush on him?
: I think you do. But what about you, Tsukasa? How do you feel?
: Mother? What are...am I in your spot? Why are you-
: Nope! Just getting a little closer to my youngest. That’s all.
: Oh...Okay. I don’t think we’ve ever been this close before.
: Not since you were a baby, no. And you’re so big now. Where has the time gone?
: I’m still nothing compared to you and Onee-sama. How much longer do you think it’ll take for me to start looking like a woman?
: What’s the rush, dear? You should be cherishing your youth. I never got the chance to do that. So at least try in my stead.
: I don’t like being young...I want people to take me seriously. I want to be able to learn things and do things without people saying I need to wait.
: It’s not fair. Like, that Otoha girl? In Chinami’s sister’s class? She said I’m way more mature than other girls my age. So why am I stuck in that bracket instead of Onee-sama’s?

: Isn’t it important for my education to not be stymied by the perpetual lack of expectation placed upon girls my age wherein every single one of us must first become acquainted with societal norms before we-
: This doesn’t sound very much like relaxing, dear.
: I’m sorry, Mother. I didn’t mean to trouble you with my rambling. I’ll be more careful in the future.
: I don’t mind your rambling, darling. I just think you’re being too hard on yourself. Nobody needs you to be anything more than you already are.
: But what I am isn’t enough...Not for you. Not for Onee-sama. Not for Jeeves. And not...
: And not for my...future husband either...
: You’re still worried about that? You know I met your father that way, don’t you?
: I know...And I know it’s my duty to do what’s best for the family, so I will. But...
: I also...
: You also what, dear?
: It’s stupid and immature and unrealistic. Just forget I said anything.
: Say it...Be stupid. Be immature. Be unrealistic. That’s what kids are supposed to do.
: Forget your duty for a minute and just say what you’re thinking. I give you permission.
: I just...
: I see the way Chinami’s sister looks when she talks about Jeeves. And Onee-sama. And also...his daughter? And they all look so...sure. That he’s the one for them.
: I want to feel that way. I want to be sure of something. And I don’t even know what this crush thing is about yet, so how am I supposed to be sure about the man you and father chose for me?
: Do you want someone to look at you the way those girls look at Akira? How would that make you feel, dear?
: Good...Like I...Like I actually matter to somebody. But nobody’s going to look at me like that the way I am now. I’m just...annoying. And little. Like a...gnat. An annoying, really smart gnat.
: Akira doesn’t think you’re a gnat, dear...
: In fact, the reason he’s so hesitant to tutor you at all is because he thinks you’re so unbearably adorable that it puts you in danger.
: Danger? Why would I be in danger with Jeeves? He’s always been so nice to me. And yeah, he’s kind of weird. But I’ve never felt in danger at all.
: Well, Tsukasa, that’s probably because it’s only dangerous from his perspective.
: I don’t...I don’t think I get what you mean.
: Well, Akira’s very big. And you’re very tiny. So if he did what he wanted to do with you, you might get hurt.
: What does he want to do with me? And what are you looking at?
: Imagine he’s in that locker right now, Tsukasa. How would you feel about him looking at you? Watching you in your current state of undress?
: Right now? Horrible. Who would look at me while you’re here? I can’t be compared to you. That’s so unfair.
: But what if he liked you more?...
: What if the reason he’s struggling so hard when it comes to teaching you is that he feels like he’s not allowed to touch you?...What would you say to him then?
: He...doesn’t...though...Jeeves isn’t like that...is he?
: If he is, you won’t think you’re annoying anymore, right? This could all be one big misunderstanding...And he could be in that locker right now jerking off to you, Tsukasa.
: Jerking...off...That...That means...masturbation, correct?
: Correct. How does that make you feel?
: I...well, I...um...I don’t...um...
: Y...You’re...really close to my ear...Would it be okay for me to sit on the opposite side of the-
: Chu...
: HYAAAAAAHHHHHHH?!?!?!?!!!
: Hahaha! Oh, that’s so cute! Your ears are just as sensitive as mine.
: M-Mother?! Why did you do that?! This is...probably...not acceptable? Maybe? Or...maybe it is?! I...I don’t know! I didn’t like it, though!
: Ooooh? But your expression says quite the opposite, dear. I think you loved it.
: I did not! Unless...Unless I was supposed to! I...I need to go do more research!
: Awww...leaving already? But I freed up my whole afternoon for you, dear.
: Well...I apologize for the inconvenience! But I...I need to go...s...somewhere else!
: Shall I give Jeeves a call and see if he wants to come give you another lesson today?
: No! No, definitely not! He’s big and...and I’m tiny! And that’s...that’s apparently bad! B...
: Bye!
: Well, Akira — it appears that-
: Ngh!
: Mnghh!!! Mnghhhh!!!
: Oh.
: Well, I suppose I deserved that. Didn’t I?
: I...I’m sorry...I was...this is...
: Oh, no. This is actually quite good. It saves me the effort of having to finish you off myself.
: You can leave now. I need to go console my daughter in ways less outwardly lascivious. Just don’t say I’ve never done anything for you.
: Tsubasa...why?
: Hysterical strength, Aki-kun.
: Hysterical strength...
I’m left to find my way out alone.
And just like that, every worker bee is back outside of the hive.
They ridicule me for not doing as they do.
Little do they know, my shift has already ended.
And, in other news-
So has the charade.
Tsubasa’s affection has increased to [tsubasa_love]!
